sources.label: Yet another Morphe Patches
sources.author: Zeldris
patch_list: AMOLED dark theme
Forces pure black surfaces across Zalo's dark theme, including the Me tab root. Light mode is untouched.
Bypass native startup tamper check
Allows the re-signed app to start on the supported arm64 Zalo build; removes other native ABIs.
Bypass Zalo Drive Contacts permission gate
Allows Drive photo restore account selection without Contacts permission.
Change Zalo app icon
Adds a user-supplied PNG icon and an in-app switch between the original and custom launcher icons.
Change Zalo app name
Changes the app name shown in the launcher.
Change Zalo package name
Allows a renamed clone alongside Zalo. Login, push, sharing and deep links may be affected.
Chat reaction picker
Allows the enabled reaction UI without a matching local subscription package. Server restrictions may still apply.
Configurable native backup interval
Sets Zalo 26.08.01's automatic backup interval to 1, 3, 6 or 12 hours. Existing backup requirements still apply. For 26.10.02 use the in-app interval settings.
Disable ads
Blocks selected offline and Google-served ads. Story and community sponsored placements require a separate patch.
Disable sponsored placements
Disables Story and community sponsored placements. Server-delivered and Official Account promotions may remain.
Disable telemetry and crash reporting
Stops selected Zalo analytics and crash reporting. Messaging is unaffected.
Enable avatar saving
Restores Save photo for avatars opened from a profile and allows screenshots. Other screenshot protections are unchanged.
Enable Google Drive photo backup
Makes Zalo's Google Drive photo backup available to more accounts. Google authorization and Drive retention still apply.
Enable profile cover saving
Restores Save photo for profile cover photos and allows screenshots. Other viewers are unchanged.
Enable stranger notifications
Adds an initially off in-app switch to allow Stranger Box notifications. Off uses Zalo's native gate; other settings and delivery restrictions still apply.
Filter promo notifications
Filters Timeline, Stories and Zalo Video notifications. Message, call, friend-request and birthday notifications are unaffected.
Hide Business Box
Hides Business Box from the chat list without hiding ordinary or user-initiated Official Account chats.
Hide chat list ads
Removes ad cards from the chat list. Server-delivered promotions and other ads may remain.
Hide Media Box
Hides Media Box from the chat list without deleting its content.
Hide navigation tabs
Adds settings to hide Discovery, Contacts and Timeline individually. Tabs stay visible until hidden in Zeldris Patches; restart to apply.
Hide Newsfeed promotions
Hides native Zinstant ad rows and suggested Zalo Video sections in Newsfeed automatically. Ordinary video posts remain visible.
Keep expired media accessible
Keeps locally stored large chat media accessible after expiry. Missing files and server restrictions are unaffected.
Keep recalled messages
Adds an initially off recall-retention switch in Zeldris Patches. Preserves locally received content with a recalled label; cannot recover missing content. Restart to apply.
microG Drive support
Uses microG-RE for Google Drive account selection and sign-in. Requires app.revanced.android.gms and the app.revanced account type.
Native backup interval settings
Adds a backup interval choice in Zeldris Patches. Native is the default; existing backup requirements apply.
Prefer original photo quality
Enables original photo quality by default. Upload limits and video are unaffected.
Remove AD_ID permission
Removes Zalo's advertising ID permissions. Messaging is unaffected.
Remove media backup age limit
Includes media of any age in Drive backup and restore. Drive retention and excluded media still apply.
Suppress outbound seen status
Stops sending read receipts while preserving delivery acknowledgements.
Suppress outbound typing status
Stops sending typing indicators. Incoming typing status is unaffected.

sources.label: Nezumi
sources.author: Nezumi
patch_list: Chat heads instead of Android bubbles
Use Zalo's overlay chat heads rather than native Android bubbles on Android 11 and newer.
Chat reaction picker
Allow the enabled chat reaction UI without a matching subscription package.
Clone package
Install an ARM64 Zalo clone alongside the original with a custom package and app name. Separate accounts are required.
Custom font
Choose a font in Nezumi's Settings for Zalo's text, chat messages, info card, options, and contacts.
Custom sounds
Choose custom notification and incoming-call sounds in Nezumi's Settings.
Drive backup via microG
Enable Google Drive photo backup and use microG for Drive accounts and authentication.
Hide Business Box in Messages
Hide the Business Box row in Messages when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Hide delivery receipts
Suppress outgoing message delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Hide Discovery tab
Remove the Discovery tab from Zalo's main navigation.
Hide feed ads
Remove sponsored and advertising items from Zalo's user feed when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Hide Media Box in Messages
Hide the Media Box row in Messages when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Hide OA accounts in Messages
Hide OA accounts in Messages and mute them permanently by default.
Hide read receipts
Keep outgoing read receipts private while retaining delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Hide text typing
Hide outgoing text typing in direct and group chats when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Keep recalled messages
Keep received messages and locally available photos after another user recalls them, when enabled in Nezumi Settings.
Native signature fix
Allow Zalo 26.10.02 ARM64 to start after patching and re-signing. ARMv7 is not supported.
View online status privately
Hide your activity and show confirmed current-online status in the individual chat header when available.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Zalo
sources.author: EHVN
patch_list: Clone app
Change Zalo package name and update the app name to allow multiple installations.
Integrate ZaloXposed
Integrates ZaloXposed using NPatch. Must be enabled for other patches to work.

patch_list: Allow Zalo to see Photos (Zalo)
Thêm Google Photos bản Morphe vào <queries> của Zalo để Zalo nhìn thấy app này.
Change Photos picker package (Zalo)
Nút Google Photos trong trình chọn ảnh của Zalo sẽ mở Google Photos bản Morphe.
